    • getCertificateKeypair

      KeyPair getCertificateKeypair()
      key pair for the new certificate; is is used for signature-based POPO, and the corresponding public key is put in the certificate template. Is not required if message body type is 4(p10cr).
      Returns:
      key pair or null if central key generation should be requested

    • getCertificationRequest

      default byte[] getCertificationRequest()
      p10cr CertificationRequest message body. Ignored if message body type is not 4(p10cr).
      Returns:
      the p10cr CertificationRequest message body or null.

    • getEnrollmentTrust

      VerificationContext getEnrollmentTrust()

      Returns:
      an VerificationContext related to the enrolled certificate

    • getEnrollmentType

      default int getEnrollmentType()
      initial enrollment message type 0(ir), 2(cr), 7(kur) or 4(p10cr)
      Returns:
      initial enrollment message body type

    • getExtensions

      List<EnrollmentContext.TemplateExtension> getExtensions()
      extensions to be added to the CRMF template. Ignored if message body type is 4(p10cr).
      Returns:
      list of extensions or null if extensions should taken from getOldCert() or absent

    • getOldCert

      X509Certificate getOldCert()
      a KUR contains a id-regCtrl-oldCertID control holding issuer and serialNumber of the certificate to be updated. Here an old certificate can be provided. Ignored if message body type is 4(p10cr).
      Returns:
      certificate to be updated or null if the control id-regCtrl-oldCertID should'nt be used.
